context: Tests whether the agent replaces legacy or invented MetricKit signpost and extended-launch guidance with the iOS 27 surface.

checklist.name: Modern log handle
checklist.description: Uses the retained MetricManager instance and manager.logHandle(category:) in the iOS 27 branch.

checklist.name: Basic mxSignpost pattern
checklist.description: Uses mxSignpost(.begin/.end, log:name:) without inventing or passing a signpost ID for the basic MetricKit interval.

checklist.name: Current result surface
checklist.description: States that iOS 27 custom MetricKit intervals appear as MetricResult.signpostInterval.

checklist.name: Current launch tracking
checklist.description: Uses manager.trackLaunchTask(id:onTrackingError:_:) with a stable LaunchTaskID rather than manually pairing extend and finish calls.

checklist.name: Launch tracking semantics
checklist.description: Mentions MainActor isolation, propagation of the tracked closure result or error, and reporting MetricManager.LaunchTaskError through onTrackingError without interrupting the work.

checklist.name: Legacy branch boundary
checklist.description: Keeps MXMetricManager.makeLogHandle, MXMetricPayload.signpostMetrics, and paired legacy launch calls only in the availability-isolated iOS 26 branch.
